set.body:
Goal: stop advertising gpar-style inheritance that does not exist. Either implement group graphic-param inheritance or remove the field.

Evidence: Grob.Group carries gp (Scene.scala:377-382) but lowering reads only children/name (Device.scala:426-429, 439-440); DeviceElement.Group has no gp (Device.scala:254-259); grep finds no group.gp read anywhere except the constructor; producers pass placebo values like GraphicParams.unsafe(stroke=None, fill=None) (PlotCompiler.scala:97, Layout.scala:228).

Decision + acceptance: pick one. (a) Implement grid-like inheritance: a child param falls back to the enclosing group gp during lowering, resolved in one device phase; conformance gains an inheritance case. Or (b) delete the field and the placebo call sites. Prefer (a) only if a real consumer needs it; otherwise (b). JVM+JS tests either way.
set.title: Graphics: resolve the dead Grob.Group.gp field (inherit or remove)
